mutation.strict_rule: KILLED divided by all outcomes except NON_VIABLE. Timeouts and uncovered mutations remain in the denominator; RUN_ERROR, MEMORY_ERROR and unknown outcomes fail validation.

preserved_historical_evidence: maintenance-20261020.json and all earlier relevance/performance protocols, labels, seals and failures remain unchanged.
measurement_scope: No new ranking experiment, held-out relevance study or performance benchmark was run. Synthetic training fixtures and generated functional workloads are correctness checks only.
compatibility: Existing manifest, job, generation, cursor request-frame and model data formats are preserved.
The extracted parser classes change parser-bundle identity. Structural strategies require an explicitly rebuilt matching API catalog and reindexed generation.
limits: The published 0.75 nDCG / 0.90 identifier-MRR target remains unmet and baseline stays selected.
Tenant-wide BM25 statistics retain repository score/order coupling.
Recovery assumes an administrator-controlled local filesystem with supported atomic rename and synchronization.
CAS/job retention remains an operator responsibility.
Source binding is deliberately conservative and unsupported/uncertain observations remain unknown.
